mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_user_id, operator_name, role_code, module_name, operation_type, operation_desc, request_url, result_status, error_message, ip_address, execution_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{roleCode}, #{moduleName}, #{operationType}, #{operationDesc}, #{requestUrl}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{ipAddress}, #{executionTime}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, operator_name AS operatorName, CASE role_code WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN '管理员' WHEN 'ASSISTANT' THEN '心理助理' WHEN 'COUNSELOR' THEN '咨询师' WHEN 'INTERVIEWER' THEN '初访员' WHEN 'STUDENT' THEN '学生' ELSE role_code END AS roleName, module_name AS moduleName, operation_type AS operationType, operation_desc AS description, result_status AS resultStatus, COALESCE(execution_time, 0) AS durationMs, ip_address AS ipAddress, create_time AS operateTime FROM operation_log
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
